text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrived for Inari One, so I immediately handed it to her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...'Watching Inari-san's exhilarating runs
always gives me energy,' huh?
Heh. That sure puts a smile on my face."
choice_data_list: Also, there was a present with the letter.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'This may be overstepping,
but I'm sending you a charm so you can always
stay happy and healthy, Inari-san.'"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. That's a pretty stylish touch.
I'll take the sentiment to heart.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now then, time to get to training! Didn't someone say a TV crew was coming? Guess I'll show 'em how majestically the great Inari-sama runs!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
――Now then! From here on, she will be showing us
how she actually runs!
Inari One, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hold on a sec.
I gotta get things ready first.
Saying so, Inari One tied the amulet given to her by her fan around her waist.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty! Sorry to keep ya waiting!
Feast yer eyes on Lady Inari's running!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Man, that was a wonderful run!
Now finally, could you give a message
to all your fans?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Well, what I wanna say is pretty simple.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—If watching me run gets people fired up
and gives 'em energy,
nothin' makes me happier than that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lady Inari shoulders all those feelings and keeps on running!
So keep on rootin' for me, ya hear?!

Every time she acted cheerfully, the charm at her waist swayed.
It was such a stylish, quintessential Inari One way of saying thanks!
